brief: The messages passed to the model. It has to be a stringified version of an array of objects. The `role` attribute of each object must be `"user"`, `"assistant"`, `"tool"`, or `"system"`. For messages of the role `"tool"`, the `content` can be a string or an arbitrary object with information about the tool call. For other messages the `content` can be either a string or a list of objects in the format `{type: "text", text:"..."}`. Some operations use a different shape. See the additional context.
examples: [{"state": "Invoice INV-2291 from Northwind Supply, issued 2026-09-02, net 30. Total: $1,080.00", "fields": {"invoice_number": {"type": "text", "instructions": "The invoice number"}, "due_date": {"type": "date", "instructions": "The date the payment is due"}, "total": {"type": "number", "unit": "USD", "decimals": 2}}}]
additional_context: For `gen_ai.decide` operations, the array holds one object `{type: "evaluation", state: ..., questions: {...}}`. `state` is the evaluated state. `questions` holds the questions keyed by name, as the caller passed them.

For `gen_ai.extract` operations, the array holds one object `{state: string, fields: {<name>: <field spec>}}`. `state` is the input text that the model reads. `fields` holds the field specs keyed by field name, as the caller passed them. Do not change the field specs.

changelog.description: Describe the extraction message shape for gen_ai.extract and move operation-specific shapes to additional context
Describe the evaluation message shape for gen_ai.evaluate
